about: Who owns what in the canal lock side example (see canal-lock-place-settings.json). Four owners build at the same time; the ground and water are built first and frozen. A stage may change only what its owner owns (collection "Place: <owner>", names, materials); the camera, lights, world and render settings are frozen, but the ground part (frozen.set_by) is the one that makes them, because it is built first. `explainer-film-place ownership-diff` and `combine` check this.

contracts.rule: walls and steps stand on the frozen bed and towpath height (seat_on_ground); the ground part never moves a wall
the gate stands on the bed
nothing from props stands on the towpath's trodden strip or a keep-clear shape
